speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, swelling in your lower legs, and unintended weight loss. To begin our investigation, have you noticed any changes in your urine output or skin color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
